meta.notes: Chiếu nghỉ hospice (vôi trắng, 2 chân nến đứng yên) → cầu thang 17 bậc xuống hầm cũ (đá vữa xương, hốc xương GLB nơi Tường lộ ra, cột gãy, người ngủ đầu tiên nơi đất vườn tràn lên nền đá) → đường hầm rễ dốc xuống vườn ngủ: bốn luống người ngủ vùi tới ngực, anh túc đỏ từ mỗi miệng, đèn ngủ hồng đứng yên bên mỗi người, mái vải lanh, cột chuông ru trên luống (overlay Chuông ru: ồn → chuông → Poppy Nurse ra từ hốc rễ), mương nước tĩnh → hành lang kênh tưới (giá phơi, mạng tơ W07) với phòng thở: Fen ngủ trong luống, Tamsin quỳ bên, nến + đèn lồng cô mang theo là ánh ấm lập lòe duy nhất → phòng thu hoạch → cầu thang xuống luống sâu (đoạn khó nhất: luống chìm vào bóng tối, dãy chuông, rễ sập chặn lối dễ, Poppy-Mound ở đường sai) nơi ngọn đèn phía trước hiện lần đầu (trắng, đứng yên, xa) → hầm thấp nhất → 9 bậc xuống The Cradle. Mọi model còn thiếu là blockout đúng cỡ (màu theo nhóm); quái trong Play là mô hình thay thế đặt theo id ASHLAR.

code.note: sha256 of the listed lab source files at export time; labCommit = lookdev-lab HEAD; uncommitted = listed files that differ from HEAD (the export used the working tree)

target.note: a 35-min dungeon: ~400 m of way over 2 floors (3–4 row halls, 2 channel galleries, the harvest room, the deep rows as a pseudo-infinite cell); this slice is 190 × 82 m, ~260 m of route

coordinateSystem.system: three.js right-handed, Y up, metres. x = east, z = south (the default game camera looks north), y = height above the ground datum (water level 0 unless the map says otherwise).
coordinateSystem.yaw: yawDeg = rotation about +Y in degrees, three.js Object3D.rotation.y (positive turns +z toward +x: a piece whose front is local +z faces (sin yaw, cos yaw): 0 = south, 90 = east, 180 = north, -90 = west).

terrain.note: interior floor: floorY(x, z) of the rooms (levels, sloping floors, stairs, ramps); NaN = no floor (outside the rooms / under the walls)

heightfield.sample: cell centre: x = x0 + (i + 0.5) * cell, z = z0 + (j + 0.5) * cell

wallShade.note: grey vertex colour of every wall vertex (multiply the base colour; vertexColors = true): c = lerp(1, topDark, smoothstep(h, top, top + fade)) * (0.82 + 0.18 * smoothstep(h, 0, 0.5)), h = vertex y minus the floor height under it (floorY(x, z), metres); `top` = the wall style top (style.top, default style.height * 0.62). The wall fades to black above its top (no ceiling: the room dissolves into darkness) and is slightly darker at the foot

floorShade.note: grey vertex colour of floor mesh corners (x, z) with dv = wallDistance(x, z) (metres; > 0 inside a room, < 0 outside / under a wall): walkable floor c = 0.86 + 0.14 * smoothstep(dv, -0.2, 1.2) (slightly darker at the walls); apron (floor cells past a void edge, not walkable, up to `apron` m) c = 0.86 * (1 - smoothstep(-dv, 0, apron * 0.8)) (fades to black)

rooms.name: Hầm thấp nhất · đầu cầu thang Cradle

A13.1.name: Sleeping bed furrow
A13.1.note: turnaround reads ≈ 1.5H long; the prompt's 2.4H × 1H is too big for one sleeper; the GLB is keyed on the 2.7 m length: a linen-draped timber box 1.16 m wide (concept 1.4 m), linen top 0.46–0.50 m; a GLB sleeper on it lies ON_GLB_BED up at SLEEPER_ON_GLB_BED of its row scale (its 1.4–1.5 m soil mound would hang over the narrower bed)

A13.2.name: Cloth canopy frame
A13.2.note: one per three beds; the awning is walk-through (the GLB canvas sags to ≈ 2.4 m), the posts block; the GLB posts lean (not a rectangle): the blockers are their 0.35–1.7 m footprints

A13.3.name: Pink night-light jar
A13.3.note: one beside every sleeper; still Perfection light (a real light every few, glow + floor pool elsewhere); the GLB's pink glass (r ≈ 0.31 m round (−0.01, 0.46, 0), in an iron-banded bowl on a stone slab) carries the light, its halo and the glowing globe (KIT globe); ×263: a collider prism keeps its 4.4 k triangles out of Play's collision

A13.4.name: Hush bell post
A13.4.reason: blockout: the lab draws a box shape (no model yet)
A13.4.note: the signature mechanic: noise within ~6 m rings it, it calls Poppy Nurses (overlay "Chuông ru") · kept as a blockout (kit swap 2026-10-23): the act1-a13-4-bell-post GLB's post rises 0.3 m over the bar and reads as a cross; the user picks it or its -trim variant (docs/act1-base/act1-kit-cross-check.png)

A13.5.name: Root-vaulted wall bay
A13.5.note: against the earth walls; the Poppy Nurses come out of these bays when a bell rings; the GLB is a shallow niche 3.5 m tall (concept 5.04 m) whose invented smooth mud-dome back (QA) sits ≈ 0.3 m inside the 0.7 m earth wall, out of sight; a box collider (its 15 k triangles × 17 stay out of Play's collision)

A13.6.name: Poppy furrow
A13.6.note: in the spines between facing rows; the GLB poppies reach 1.76 m (concept 1.26 m); the collider covers the 1.0 m planter (foot), the leaning stems stay walk-through

N-GD01.name: Root rib arch
N-GD01.approx: warp variant "slim" (squeeze_z): a NON-affine bend of the base model; the matrix is the base model's (no re-centre), the bend is not applied
N-GD01.note: one great root arching over a passage: the ribs of the root vault (no ceilings in the lab); the -slim GLB (root feet squeezed to 1.94 m deep), 4.05 m tall (concept 4.9 m); the feet block (x < −0.85 and > +1.45 at walking height), the 2.3 m lane between them is centred at x +0.3, off the pivot; the thin rootlets that hung into the lane (to 0.74–1.02 m at x −0.85…−0.49 and +0.75…+1.15) are cut below 2.05 m, so the lane keeps ≥ 2 m headroom
